# assignment-secrets: an opaque value assigned to a credential-shaped key.
# format: <rule id> TAB <line>. the test expands the placeholder, so no opaque literal is stored here.
generic-api-key	api_key = "{S32}"
generic-high-entropy-value	token = "{S40}"
generic-high-entropy-value	PRIVATE_KEY=0x{HEX64}
generic-high-entropy-value	api_key: "{HEX40}"
generic-secret-assignment	client_secret = "{S32}"
generic-password-assignment	password: "{S32}"
# the unquoted named-key forms: a whole key at line start, `KEY=value`, `export KEY=value` or yaml
# `key: value`, detected by the contextual rules without the heuristic rule.
generic-api-key	export API_TOKEN={S32}
generic-api-key	API_KEY={S32}
generic-api-key	  api-key: {S32}  # service account
generic-secret-assignment	SECRET_KEY={S32}
generic-secret-assignment	client_secret={S32}
generic-token-assignment	auth_token={S32}
generic-token-assignment	ACCESS_TOKEN = {S32}
generic-token-assignment	GITHUB_TOKEN={S40}
generic-token-assignment	  token: {S32}  # rotated weekly
